title: The Water's Returning Path

features.name: the underground stream
features.desc-on-touch: water that has learned the path it will always follow; each return traces the channel a little deeper into memory

features.name: the confluence-shadow
features.desc-on-touch: where the returning water meets its younger self, coming down from the source; they do not mix but remember doing so

features.name: the channel-archive
features.desc-on-touch: files caught in stone where the water has carved its own history; records of what the return has carried

features.name: the cycle-marker
features.desc-on-touch: stone carved by ten thousand returns; each passing has written the same mark deeper until it reads like a frequency

features.name: the old channels
features.desc-on-touch: paths the water took in previous years, now abandoned but still present; the return knows them by heart without using them

features.name: the adaptation-point
features.desc-on-touch: where returning water has learned to flow differently than it once did, carrying stories of other adaptations it has witnessed

inscription: every river follows its own old channels until it learns to carve new ones; the return is how water remembers being young

file.name: Stream_Adaptation_Records_Where_Water_Learns_Previous_Paths_1992.mp3
file.note: field recording of water moving through stone, corrupted with what sounds like a story being retold — each telling following the same shape, changing slightly

exits.label: back to the source, where water has not yet learned to return
deeper underground, where the path becomes unmappable
upward where the stream emerges and daylight returns it to sky
